diluted_eps.quote: Diluted net income per common share | $ | 2.31 | $ | 9.11

management.claim: Management says Google Cloud revenue growth accelerated sharply.
management.quote: Google Cloud saw a meaningful acceleration in growth as revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion

management.claim: Management says operating income grew and operating margin widened.
management.quote: Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% and operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.

management.claim: Management says other income included a large gain on equity securities.
management.quote: Other income reflected a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily the result of net unrealized gains on our equity securities.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls the quarter amazing and cites strong momentum across the business.

guidance.text: Amazon expects third quarter 2026 net sales of $197.0 billion to $202.0 billion.
guidance.quote: Net sales are expected to be between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, or to grow between 9% and 12% compared with third quarter 2025.

management.claim: Management says AWS grew at its fastest rate in 18 quarters.
management.quote: AWS is booming, growing 36.7% year-over-year in Q2—our fastest growth in 18 quarters

management.claim: Management says net income includes large other income, mainly from Anthropic investments.
management.quote: Second quarter 2026 net income includes non-operating pre-tax other income of $53.4 billion, primarily from our investments in Anthropic.

management.claim: Management expects third quarter operating income of $22.5 billion to $26.5 billion.
management.quote: Operating income is expected to be between $22.5 billion and $26.5 billion, compared with $17.4 billion in third quarter 2025.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO says AWS is booming and there is much more coming for customers.

guidance.text: Meta expects fourth quarter 2026 total revenue of $73-76 billion.
guidance.quote: We expect fourth quarter 2026 total revenue to be in the range of $73-76 billion.

management.claim: The CEO says the core business is strong and investments are paying off.
management.quote: Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we're seeing velocity across the board.

management.claim: Management says costs include a charge for the agreement with state attorneys general.
management.quote: Third quarter 2026 costs and expenses includes a $9.89 billion charge related to this agreement.

management.claim: Management reports revenue growth of 26% on a reported and constant currency basis.
management.quote: Revenue was $64.60 billion, an increase of 26% year-over-year on both a reported and constant currency basis.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls the core business strong and cites velocity across the board.

management.claim: The CEO says EPS rose 14.7% and core revenues rose 1.0% year on year.
management.quote: We delivered another strong quarter, with year-over-year increases of 14.7% in EPS and 1.0% in core revenues.

management.claim: The CEO describes stable credit quality and disciplined expense management.
management.quote: stable credit quality and core deposit balances, disciplined expense management, and healthy profitability

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO calls it another strong quarter with healthy profitability.

management.claim: Management reports quarterly revenue fell 8% on lower product sales.
management.quote: Total revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 decreased 8% to $5.83 million from $6.35 million for the prior-year quarter.

management.claim: The CEO is pleased with six-month revenue growth despite the quarterly fall.
management.quote: We’re pleased to report a 36% increase in revenue for the six months ended September 30, 2026

tone.label: balanced
tone.reason: The CEO is pleased with six-month growth but notes the quarterly revenue decrease.

guidance.text: Management expects the fourth-quarter momentum in LYMPHIR demand to carry into fiscal 2027. No numerical outlook is given.
guidance.quote: As we enter fiscal 2027, we expect the momentum we built in the fourth quarter to carry forward

management.claim: Unit sales of LYMPHIR to wholesalers more than doubled in the quarter.
management.quote: Unit sales to wholesalers more than doubled as our expanded commercial team reached nationwide coverage in August

management.claim: Management says it is more than halfway to its formulary goal.
management.quote: We are now more than halfway to our goal of having LYMPHIR on formulary at 100 priority institutions by calendar year-end.

management.claim: Management expects growing demand and continued sales growth.
management.quote: with growing institutional demand, deeper penetration into academic and community treatment centers, and continued sales growth as LYMPHIR becomes further established in CTCL

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The CEO describes continued demand, doubled unit sales and expected momentum into fiscal 2027.

net_income.quote: Net Income Available to Common Shareholders | $ | 34,609

management.claim: The company reports record quarterly diluted earnings per share.
management.quote: today announced net income of $34.6 million and record quarterly diluted earnings of $2.43 per share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026

management.claim: Net interest income rose 3.0% from the second quarter and the margin widened.
management.quote: The Company’s reported net interest margin increased from 3.97% for the second quarter of 2026 to 4.04% for the third quarter of 2026.

management.claim: Non-interest expenses rose from a year earlier, mainly on salaries and benefits.
management.quote: Non-interest expenses increased $2.6 million from $38.3 million in the third quarter of 2025 to $40.9 million in the third quarter of 2026.

tone.label: positive
tone.reason: The release calls the results record, reports a wider margin and stable credit quality, and raises the dividend.
